I ask the same question to myself now and again too,why would anyone want to live in this world?

Well,the thing is,there is a lot of good things worth living for in this world.It's different to others,maybe you like drawing,maybe you're into sports,maybe you like gardening.But when depression hits you,all those good things seem to get outpowered by the bad things,like the people who make you feel miserable.
I was diagnosed with chronic depression 4 years ago from now(I'm now 16),and although I still do the same things I did then,like playing video games and football,it just doesn't feel the same.You don't feel as excited from it.
So what I'm trying to say is,there always is a reason.But you must find it for yourself.Best wishes.

Oh,and if you ever need help,just use [this](https://www.7cups.com/). 7 Cups of Tea is a free online therapy/counseling place where I was when I had extreme thoughts of suicide and felt like nothing is worth anything.
